hints.title: Level Insertion Target
hints.text: Inserting a row of nodes at depth d requires creating new parent links for all existing nodes at depth d.

hints.title: Depth 1 Root Replacement
hints.text: If depth is 1, instantiate a new root with given value whose left child points to original root.

hints.title: Depth d-1 Splice Modification
hints.text: Traverse down to depth d - 1. For each node, create new_left = TreeNode(val, node.left, None) and new_right = TreeNode(val, None, node.right), then assign node.left = new_left and node.right = new_right.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Traversal stops at depth d - 1 and splices new children in O(1) time each.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding the entire tree from scratch is unnecessary and consumes extra memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place pointer redirection modifies tree structure in O(H) stack depth.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle depth == 1 edge case cleanly and insert new level nodes in-place.
